shellCommands.command: git status --short && git ls-files | head -100 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null
ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "---"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; cat tsconfig.json; echo "---"; cat .gitignore; echo "---"; node -v; npm -v

grep -o '"[A-Za-z]*Calendar[A-Za-z]*"\|DatePicker' -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sort -u; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -80; echo "---"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui | cat; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "date|calendar|dayjs"
ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/lab; timeout 60 npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -60

timeout 90 npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -40; for v in $(timeout 90 npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[],"' | grep -E '^[0-9]' | sort -V | tail -40); do echo -n "$v: "; timeout 30 npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n ' ; echo; done 2>/dev/null | grep -E "uikit" | head -40
for v in 2.12.0 3.0.3 3.2.4 3.4.2 4.0.0 4.1.0; do echo "== $v"; timeout 30 npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | grep -E "uikit|date-utils|react\"" ; done
timeout 300 npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "---"; grep -A12 '"dependencies"' package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && cat package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types|style|exports)"' ; ls; ls build 2>/dev/null | head; find . -name "*.d.ts" -path "*DatePicker*" | head -5; find . -name "index.d.ts" | head -3

cat dist/esm/components/DatePicker/DatePicker.d.ts; echo "=== index"; cat dist/esm/index.d.ts; echo "=== components"; cat dist/esm/components/index.d.ts; echo "=== css"; grep -o '"./[^"]*css[^"]*"' package.json; ls dist/esm | head -30; echo "=== peer/readme sample"; grep -n -i -A12 "DatePicker" README.md | head -60
cat dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; echo "=== common"; cat dist/esm/components/Calendar/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; ls dist/esm/components/Calendar/

cat dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts; echo "=== types"; cat dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts | head -40; echo "=== dateutils exports"; cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils && grep -E '"(main|types)"' package.json; grep -rho "export declare function dateTime[^;]*" dist/esm 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -rn "export.*settings" dist/esm/index.d.ts | head; grep -rho "loadLocale[^;]*" dist/esm/*.d.ts dist/esm/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3

grep -n "dateTime\|settings" build/index.d.ts | head -20; echo "---"; grep -rn "export declare const settings\|loadLocale" build/*.d.ts build/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "--- uikit ThemeProvider lang"; grep -n "lang" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "lang" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && grep -rn -A8 "interface ValueBase" dist/esm/components/types/*.d.ts | head -20; echo "--- DateTime"; cd ../date-utils && grep -rn "format(" build/dateTime/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls build | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build && ls typings dateTime | head -30; grep -rn "format\|toDate\|toISOString" typings/*.d.ts | head -10
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && timeout 300 npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; timeout 300 npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -15
which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i playwright; python3 -c "import playwright" 2>&1 | tail -1
mkdir -p /tmp/e2e && cd /tmp/e2e && timeout 300 npm init -y >/dev/null && timeout 300 npm install playwright@1.49.1 2>&1 | tail -2 && timeout 400 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5
cd /tmp/e2e && timeout 400 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*at " | head -15

cat > /tmp/ssr-check/build.mjs <<'EOF'
import { build } from '/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/esbuild/lib/main.js';
await build({
  entryPoints: ['/tmp/ssr-check/entry.tsx'],
  bundle: true,
  platform: 'node',
  format: 'esm',
  jsx: 'automatic',
  loader: { '.css': 'empty' },
  outfile: '/tmp/ssr-check/out.mjs',
  nodePaths: ['/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules'],
  logLevel: 'warning',
});
EOF
timeout 120 node /tmp/ssr-check/build.mjs && timeout 60 node /tmp/ssr-check/out.mjs 2>&1 | tail -20

sed -i "s/format: 'esm'/format: 'cjs'/; s#outfile: '/tmp/ssr-check/out.mjs'#outfile: '/tmp/ssr-check/out.cjs'#" /tmp/ssr-check/build.mjs && timeout 120 node /tmp/ssr-check/build.mjs && timeout 60 node /tmp/ssr-check/out.cjs 2>&1 | tail -20
rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- package.json && cat src/App.tsx
